description_en: Queries the parameter information of a host in a dedicated cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeDedicatedHostAttribute接口查询专属集群某个主机的参数信息
name: DescribeDedicatedHostAttribute

parameters.help_en: The host ID. You can log on to the ApsaraDB dedicated cluster console and obtain the host ID on the Hosts page
parameters.name: dedicated_host_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the dedicated cluster to which the host belongs. You can log on to the ApsaraDB dedicated cluster console and obtain the cluster ID on the Clusters page
parameters.name: dedicated_host_group_id

AccountName.description_en:
The name of the host account.

It must contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).

It must start with a letter and end with a letter or digit.

It must be 2 to 16 characters in length
AccountName.description_zh:
主机账号名称。

由小写字母、数字、下划线组成。

以字母开头，以字母或数字结尾。

包含2~16个字符

AccountType.description_en:
The account type. Valid values:

Normal: standard account
Admin: administrator account
AccountType.description_zh:
账号类型，取值：

Normal：普通权限账号。
Admin：管理员账号

AllocationStatus.description_en:
Specifies whether instances can be allocated to the host. Valid values:

Allocatable: Instances can be allocated.
Suspended: Instance allocation is suspended
AllocationStatus.description_zh:
主机是否可分配实例，取值：

Allocatable：该主机允许分配实例。
Suspended：该主机停止分配实例

AutoRenew.description_en:
Specifies whether auto-renewal is enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled. This is the default value
AutoRenew.description_zh:
是否开启自动续费功能。取值为：
true：开启。
false：不开启。

不填写默认为false

CPUAllocationRatio.description_en: The CPU overcommit ratio of the dedicated cluster. Unit: %. Accurate to 10%
CPUAllocationRatio.description_zh: 专属集群的cpu超配比，单位为百分比，精确到10%

CpuUsed.description_en: The CPU usage of the host

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the host was created. The time follows the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and is displayed in UTC
CreatedTime.description_zh: 主机创建成功的时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

DedicatedHostGroupId.description_en: The ID of the dedicated cluster to which the host belongs

DiskAllocationRatio.description_en: The storage overcommit ratio of the dedicated cluster
DiskAllocationRatio.description_zh:
专属集群的空间超配比。

取值范围：100%~300%，默认取值为200%，代表所有实例的空间资源之和可以是实际空间资源的2倍，充分利用资源

DistributionTag.description_en: The distribution tag of the host

ExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the host. The time follows the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and is displayed in UTC
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 主机到期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

HostCPU.description_en: The number of CPU cores of the host

HostMem.description_en: The memory capacity of the host. Unit: MB

HostStatus.description_en:
The status of the host. Valid values:

0: Creating.
1: Running.
2: Faulty.
3: Pending offline.
4: Under maintenance.
5: Offline.
6: Restarting.
7: Locked.

When a host becomes faulty, it will be taken offline. Before the host is taken offline, instances on the faulty host are migrated to ensure data integrity
HostStatus.description_zh:
主机状态，取值：

0：创建中
1：运行中
2：故障中
3：准备下线
4：维护中
5：已下线
6：重启中
7：锁定中

当主机出现故障时，主机要下线，主机下线之前会将该故障主机上的实例进行迁移，从而保证数据的完整性

HostStorage.description_en: The total storage capacity of the host. Unit: GB
HostStorage.description_zh: 主机的存储总量，单位为GB

HostType.description_en:
The storage type of the host. Valid values:

dhg_cloud_ssd and dhg_cloud_essd: ESSD cloud disk

dhg_local_ssd: local SSD
HostType.description_zh:
主机的存储类型。取值：

本地SSD盘：实例所在物理机的本地存储。该类存储为实例提供块级别的数据访问能力，具有低时延、高随机 IOPS、高吞吐量的 I/O 能力。
ESSD云盘：适用于时延敏感的应用或者I/O密集型业务场景。

不同引擎支持的存储类型不同，请以控制台为准

IPAddress.description_en: The IP address of the host

ImageCategory.description_en:
The host image. This parameter is returned when the engine type is SQL Server. Valid values:

WindowsWithMssqlEntAlwaysonLicense: SQL Server Cluster Edition

WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense: SQL Server Standard Edition

WindowsWithMssqlEntLicense: SQL Server Enterprise Edition

WindowsWithMssqlWebLicense: SQL Server Web Edition
ImageCategory.description_zh:
主机镜像。仅在Engine参数为mssql时返回，返回值：

WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense：Windows（含SQL Server标准版License）。
WindowsWithMssqlEntLisence：Windows（含SQL Server企业版License）。
WindowsWithMssqlWebLisence：Windows（含SQL ServerWeb版License）

InstanceNumber.description_en: The number of instances deployed on the host

InstanceNumberMaster.description_en: The number of primary nodes on the host

InstanceNumberROMaster.description_en: The number of primary nodes of read-only instances on the host
InstanceNumberROMaster.description_zh: 主机上只读实例的主节点数

InstanceNumberROSlave.description_en: The number of secondary nodes of read-only instances on the host
InstanceNumberROSlave.description_zh: 主机上只读实例的备节点数

InstanceNumberSlave.description_en: The number of secondary nodes on the host

MemAllocationRatio.description_zh: 内存使用率，单位为百分比

MemoryUsed.description_en: The memory usage of the host. Unit: GB
MemoryUsed.description_zh: 主机内存使用量，单位为GB

OpenPermission.description_en:
Specifies whether the OS permissions of the host in the dedicated cluster are granted. Valid values:

0: Not granted.
1: Granted
OpenPermission.description_zh:
是否开放专属集群内的主机的OS权限。取值：

0：关闭
1：开放

RegionId.description_zh: 主机所在地域ID。可查看[地域信息]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198326.html）获取

StorageUsed.description_en: The storage usage of the host. Unit: GB
StorageUsed.description_zh: 主机的存储使用量，单位为GB
